notes.title: Part 2 DLC - Announcement
notes.content:
The plan is for part two to be similar in scope and playtime to part one, expanding and deepening, as well as introducing some new mechanics.

Since I'm almost a solo developer and combining the work with another job, it takes some time. But I think it will be worth the wait. The goal is to release part two later this year!

To show support and not miss out on the drop, Wishlist the DLC here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3722560

notes.title: Locomotion fixes!
notes.content:
Locomotion fixes

 Easier to pick things up from the ground
 Less slipping and sliding
 Fixed smooth locomotion stopping when walking downhill


Bug fixes

Fixed bugs where game ended up in the wrong state after starting new game coming back from another save slot
 More minor bug fixes

notes.title: Save System Update!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers of the Coral Sea!

Is it really a game if it doesn't have save functionality? Now we don't need to think about such philosophical questions anymore, because saving is implemented! You can now calmly take a break without worry, maybe walk your dog, cork up a fine Bourgogne, or take a dump, before you head back in to finish off the game.

New features

 Auto save functionality with three save slots
 Steam Cloud save integration
 Quality of life changes


Other improvements

 Bug fixes
 Performance enhancements
